parsed_json.up_exec: Return distinct IC50 activity rows (in nM) for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2039 (Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B). For each qualifying activity, include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID, fall back to DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is available.
